units.source_text: 那家将的眼睛，在这时候，才看见蹲在死尸中的一个人。

en.t: Only then did the servant's eyes notice a person crouching among the corpses.

units.source_text: 是穿一件桧皮色衣服的，又短又瘦的，白头发的，猴子似的老妪。

en.t: It was a short, thin, white-haired old woman, dressed in a cypress-bark-colored robe and looking like a monkey.

units.source_text: 这老妪，右手拿着点火的松明，注视着死尸之一的脸。

en.t: The old woman held a lit torch in her right hand and stared at the face of one of the corpses.

units.source_text: 从头发的长短看来，那死尸大概是女的。

en.t: Judging from the length of the hair, the corpse was probably a woman.
